protocol_only.deviation_from_original: Port-only probe adapted to protocol number; the canonical CSV retains no port.

condition_only.description: The declared nuisance variable used alone as a predictor.
condition_only.deviation_from_original: Diagnostic probe, not a published baseline.

port_only.description: Destination port alone -- the classic encrypted-traffic shortcut.

sni_only.description: TLS/QUIC SNI string alone. If this wins, the task is name resolution, not traffic analysis.

capture_id_only.description: Capture session identifier alone. Near-perfect under a random split, useless under a session-disjoint one.

five_stat.description: Five flow-summary statistics, the classic NetFlow-style baseline.

flow_meta.description: All flow-level scalars present in the canonical CSV.

cumul.deviation_from_original: Panchenko et al. fit an RBF-SVM with a grid search over C and gamma on the full training set. We fit an RBF-SVM with scikit-learn defaults on a stratified subsample of at most 8,000 rows (see subsampled_train_rows). Both deviations can only understate CUMUL, so it is a lower bound on what this feature set achieves.

appscanner.description: AppScanner, Taylor et al., IEEE EuroS&P 2016.

kfp.description: k-fingerprinting, Hayes and Danezis, USENIX Security 2016 (count/order/concentration/burst groups).
kfp.deviation_from_original: Hayes and Danezis use random-forest leaf vectors followed by a k-NN stage. We report the random forest directly, which is the standard simplification in the literature.

majority_class.description: Always predict the most frequent training class.
